en.question: I Ritual Summon <<22539>> to the Main Monster Zone, and activate its『(...), then if this card is in the Extra Monster Zone, you can banish all Spells and Traps from your opponent's Graveyard』effect. Can my opponent activate <<13587>>'s effect in response?
en.title: If <<22539>>'s effect is activated in the Main Monster Zone, can I activate <<13587>>'s effect in response?
